I cleared all the findings listed in #297, and `ruff check --config .trunk/configs/ruff.toml .` now reports nothing. The changed files compile (`py_compile`), but I didn't run the app or any tests. I haven't committed anything.

- **PLR2004:** I replaced the magic numbers with named constants in `app/examples/components.py`, `app/www/frontmatter.py`, `cli/main.py` and `dev.py`.
- **ARG001:** I added a `noqa` with a reason in `app/templates/toc.py` and `app/www/style.py`. I kept the unused arguments because other code passes them.
- **S603:** I added a `noqa` with a reason in `dev.py` and `scripts/run_all.py`.
- **SIM102:** In `scripts/generate_markdown.py` I flattened the nested `if` and simplified its condition. The registry should come out the same, but I didn't run the generator to check.
- **EXE001:** I made `scripts/generate_registry.py` executable.
- **RUF001:** In `app/export.py` the en dash in the title string is now written as `\u2013`, so the page title is unchanged.
- **ICN001:** `app/www/library/charts/area/v5.py` now imports `datetime as dt`.
- **D107:** I added a `noqa` with a reason on `__init__` in `app/www/parser.py`, since the class docstring already covers it.

Ruff also flagged `*args` and `**kwargs` without annotations in `app/templates/layout.py`, which wasn't in the issue. I annotated them as `Any`.
